function.name: locate_tallest_mountains
function.description: Find the tallest mountains within a specified radius of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city from which to calculate distance.

radius.description: The radius within which to find mountains, measured in kilometers. This is a float type value.

amount.description: The number of mountains to find, listed from tallest to smallest.

function.name: calculate_electric_field
function.description: Calculate the electric field produced by a charge at a certain distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

charge.description: Charge in coulombs producing the electric field. This is a float type value.

distance.description: Distance from the charge in meters where the field is being measured. This is a float type value.

permitivity.description: Permitivity of the space where field is being calculated, default is for vacuum. This is a float type value.

message.content:
**Common proteins found in the plasma membrane** | Category | Typical proteins | Function | |----------|------------------|----------| | **Integral (transmembrane) proteins** | • **Na⁺/K⁺‑ATPase** – pumps Na⁺ out and K⁺ in
• **Glucose transporter 1 (GLUT1)** – facilitates glucose uptake
• **G‑protein coupled receptors (GPCRs)** – e.g., β‑adrenergic receptor, dopamine receptor
• **Ion channels** – e.g., voltage‑gated Na⁺ channel, Ca²⁺ channel, K⁺ channel
• **Receptor tyrosine kinases** – e.g., epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)
• **Integrins** – mediate cell‑matrix adhesion
• **Cadherins** – mediate cell‑cell adhesion
• **Connexins** – form gap junction channels
• **Aquaporins** – water channels (e.g., AQP4) | Transmembrane transport, signal transduction, cell adhesion, intercellular communication | | **Peripheral (non‑integral) proteins** | • **Annexins** – bind phospholipids in a Ca²⁺‑dependent manner
• **Spectrin** – cytoskeletal scaffold
• **Actin‑binding proteins** – e.g., profilin, cofilin
• **Glycophorins** – sialylated glycoproteins on erythrocytes
• **MHC class I & II molecules** – antigen presentation (also integral but often listed here for their peripheral interactions) | Structural support, signaling complexes, immune recognition | | **Glycoproteins / Glycolipids** | • **Mucin** – forms protective mucus layer
• **Glycosphingolipids** – e.g., GM1 ganglioside | Cell‑surface recognition, protection, signaling | These proteins together give the plasma membrane its selective permeability, signaling capabilities, and structural integrity.
